budget_interpretation.limit: Producer phases precede controller work. Validation/file I/O, locking and setup do not acquire a new whole-wrapper hard deadline merely because the existing controller has a 600-second budget. No deadline or recovery policy was changed or operationally proved by this review.

nonblocking_limits: The pre-token lexists check is advisory preflight, not atomic reservation. Another invocation could pass that check before the existing controller obtains its exclusive lock/reservation. Once/no-retry describes this invocation's source/consumer control flow; global one-use authority remains the existing controller reservation and explicit operator instruction, not the flag name.

entrypoint_handoff_entered=true means the wrapper reached the helper handoff attempt. It is not proof that the controller reserved an attempt or executed a service mutation; controller receipts/outcomes remain authoritative.

The executable branch is prepared capability only. Actual CLI/token-source permission, live credential handoff, fresh resource/configuration/source checks, startup, worker shutdown/ack, cancellation/recovery, final network configuration and a cited explanation remain UNVERIFIED.
